product_metadata.title: X-FLOAT Rainbow Iridescent Acrylic Display Risers (Set of 6)
features: Multi-Colored – One-of-a-kind acrylic display risers with a rainbow iridescent finish so it changes color depending on the light conditions and the viewing angle.
Simple and Stylish – Semi transparent display and organize your prized possessions. Perfect for kids rooms, bedrooms, bathrooms, living rooms or kitchens.
Durable Acrylic – Made from strong premium acrylic to showcase favorite small objects and fixtures like jewelry, watches, toys, collectibles, action figures, vinyl figures and more.
Sizing – Each set comes with 6 acrylic display risers in 3 different sizes. Large: 3x3x5.25” Medium: 3x2x4.5” Small: 3x1.25x3.5”
Easy Installation – Simply peel off the protective film from both sides of each acrylic display riser and start showcasing your small collectibles!
